zh: 填充：在明文末尾追加额外比特或字节，使最后一个块或段完整。
块对齐：明文长度是分组大小的整数倍。
PKCS#7 填充：追加 n 个值为 n 的字节，n 由块大小和消息长度决定。
CMS 填充：RFC 5652 继承的字节填充规则，与 PKCS#7 相同。
整块填充：消息已经对齐时仍追加一整个块。
移除填充：读取最后一个字节 n，校验末尾 n 个字节都等于 n。
填充预言机：能判断修改后的密文是否具有正确填充的接口。
填充错误：解密后填充不符合规则；错误处理不当会泄露信息。
MAC-then-encrypt：先认证再加密的构造，TLS CBC 套件曾使用。
encrypt-then-MAC：先加密再认证的构造，可避免填充预言机。
AEAD：同时提供机密性和完整性的认证加密。
en: Padding: extra bits or bytes appended to plaintext so the final block or segment is complete.
Block alignment: plaintext length is a multiple of the block size.
PKCS#7 padding: append n bytes each valued n, where n depends on the block size and message length.
CMS padding: the byte-padding rule inherited by RFC 5652, identical to PKCS#7.
Padding string: one of 01, 02 02, ..., k k ... k k.
Full-block padding: a whole block is appended even when the message is already aligned.
Padding removal: read the last byte n and check that the last n bytes all equal n.
Padding oracle: an interface that tells whether a modified ciphertext has correct padding.
Padding error: decrypted padding does not follow the rule; poor error handling leaks information.
MAC-then-encrypt: authenticate then encrypt, a construction used by TLS CBC ciphersuites.
Encrypt-then-MAC: encrypt then authenticate, which avoids padding oracles.
AEAD: authenticated encryption providing confidentiality and integrity together.
